commands.name: active_source_imports
command: import pkgutil,src; names=[m.name for m in pkgutil.iter_modules(src.__path__)]; [__import__('src.'+n) for n in names]; print('active imports PASS',len(names),sorted(names))

commands.name: final_zip_verification
command: from src.artifacts import verify_zip; import json; r=verify_zip(); print(json.dumps(r,indent=2)); raise SystemExit(0 if r['status']=='PASS' else 1)

commands.name: gate_evidence_validation
command: import json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('results/phase3'); names=['gate_a_report.json','gate_b_report.json','gate_c_report.json','checkpoint_roundtrip.json']; rows={n:json.loads((p/n).read_text())['status'] for n in names}; print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)); raise SystemExit(0 if all(v=='PASS' for v in rows.values()) else 1)

commands.name: manifest_hash_verification
command: from src.artifacts import verify_manifest; import json; r=verify_manifest(); print(json.dumps(r,indent=2)); raise SystemExit(0 if r['status']=='PASS' else 1)

commands.name: notebook_execution_check
command: import json,pathlib; out={}; ok=True; [None for p in [pathlib.Path('notebooks/Phase3_Research.ipynb'),pathlib.Path('notebooks/Phase3_Explained_FA.ipynb')] for n in [json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))] for code in [[c for c in n['cells'] if c['cell_type']=='code']] for errors in [[o for c in code for o in c.get('outputs',[]) if o.get('output_type')=='error']] for executed in [sum(c.get('execution_count') is not None for c in code)] for _ in [out.update({p.name:{'code_cells':len(code),'executed_cells':executed,'error_outputs':len(errors)}})] for __ in [globals().__setitem__('ok',globals()['ok'] and executed==len(code) and not errors)]]; print(json.dumps(out,indent=2)); raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)

commands.name: numerical_audit_evidence
command: import json,pathlib; r=json.loads(pathlib.Path('results/phase3/numerical_audit.json').read_text()); print(json.dumps({'status':r['status'],'audited_sample_count':r['audited_sample_count'],'failed_sample_count':r['failed_sample_count'],'sinkhorn_iterations':r['sinkhorn_iterations']},indent=2)); raise SystemExit(0 if r['status']=='PASS' and r['failed_sample_count']==0 else 1)

commands.name: report_consistency
command: from src.reporting import verify_report_consistency; import json; r=verify_report_consistency(); print(json.dumps(r,indent=2)); raise SystemExit(0 if r['status']=='PASS' else 1)
